replace.why: f_comm_DP.h line 4. Left quoted, MSVC resolves it from include/function/ (the same-directory rule) and gets the REAL f_funcCode.h -- a hub that pulls DSP28x_Project.h / f_debug.h / f_interface.h / f_p2p.h and, through them, most of the project. The gen_dir copy (cases/f_comm_DP/shim/f_funcCode.h) would never be reached. Angle brackets drop the same-directory rule; gen_dir is first on the include path, so the stub wins. Only the quote style changes -- every #define in this header stays as the firmware has it, which is the whole point of forwarding it real.
